name: Tally counts add to 24 and match the About totals

planSteps.description: Stay on the page that is already open at the start URL and do not navigate to any other address: the chart is on that page. Wait 4 seconds for the chart to settle

Compare the tally under the title with these exact expected numbers: tally-read 17, tally-misread 4, tally-blocked 3, tally-unread 0, sum 24. That is: 'Read correctly' shows 17, 'Misread' shows 4, 'Blocked' shows 3, 'Not read yet' shows 0. Fail if any shown number differs from its expected number, for example Read correctly 16, or if the four do not add to 24
The reading-summary line below the tally must contain the exact text 'Read correctly: 17 of 24 letters'. Fail if it shows any other pair of numbers, for example 'Read correctly: 16 of 23 letters'
